record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: Distances between H^1 homotopy classes on S^2
record.original_question: For maps f:S^2→S^2 in H^1, let Ed be the class of maps of degree d, and define Dist_{H^1}(Ed1,Ed2)=sup_{f∈Ed1} inf_{g∈Ed2} ||∇(f-g)||_{L^2}. Is Dist_{H^1}(Ed1,Ed2)^2 = 8π|d1-d2| for all integers d1,d2? Even more basically, is Dist_{H^1}(Ed1,Ed2)=Dist_{H^1}(Ed2,Ed1) for all d1,d2?

evidence.quote: Consider e.g. H1(S2; S2) and its homotopy classes Ed = {f ∈ H1(S2; S2); deg f = d}, d ∈ Z. The quantity of interest is DistH1 (Ed1, Ed2) = Sup f∈Ed1 Inf g∈Ed2 ||∇(f − g)||L2.

Open Problem 5.9 ([BMS]). Is true that (5.28) Dist2 H1 (Ed1, Ed2) = 8π|d1 − d2| ∀d1, d2 ∈ Z? The inequality ≤ is known, (see [BMS] and the references therein) but the reverse inequality (≥) has been established only when d2 > d1 ≥ 0. Even a much easier problem is open: Is it true that DistH1 (Ed1, Ed2) = DistH1 (Ed2, Ed1) ∀d1, d2 ∈ Z?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^2$ denote the standard unit sphere in $\mathbb{R}^3$, and let $H^1(S^2;S^2)$ be the space of measurable maps $f:S^2\to S^2$ with $\int_{S^2}|\nabla f|^2\,d\sigma<\infty$ (where $\nabla$ is the tangential gradient on $S^2$). Every $f\in H^1(S^2;S^2)$ has a well-defined integer Brouwer degree $\deg f\in\mathbb{Z}$, and for each $d\in\mathbb{Z}$ define the homotopy class
$$E_d=\{f\in H^1(S^2;S^2):\deg f=d\}.$$
For $d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}$ define the asymmetric distance
$$\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})=\sup_{f\in E_{d_1}}\inf_{g\in E_{d_2}}\|\nabla(f-g)\|_{L^2(S^2)}.$$

(a) Prove or disprove that
$$\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})^2=8\pi\,|d_1-d_2|\qquad\text{for all }d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}.$$

(b) Prove or disprove the (a priori weaker) symmetry statement
$$\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})=\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_2},E_{d_1})\qquad\text{for all }d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The upper bound $\mathrm{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})^2\le 8\pi|d_1-d_2|$ is established, and the matching lower bound is known in the case $d_2>d_1\ge 0$ (work of Brezis–Mironescu–Shafrir on distances between homotopy classes of $W^{s,p}(S^N;S^N)$, including the 2016 article in ESAIM COCV and the HAL preprint hal-01308505). The general equality for all integers $d_1,d_2$, and even the symmetry question, do not appear resolved in the literature located.

status_evidence.title: Distances between classes of sphere-valued Sobolev maps (Brezis–Mironescu–Shafrir)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Dist_{W^{s,p}}(E_{d1},E_{d2}) for sphere-valued Sobolev maps; obtains the inequality ≤ and discusses cases where equality is known.
status_evidence.claim: The ≤ direction is established and equality is proven in restricted cases.

status_evidence.title: Some of my favorite open problems (Brezis)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists the question whether Dist_{H^1}(E_{d1},E_{d2})^2 = 8π|d1−d2| as an open problem, noting only ≤ is known in general and ≥ only for d2>d1≥0.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as open, with partial progress noted.
